appearance_facts.fact: The blue Hydroelectricity point for 2010 is positioned at a lower vertical level than the red dashed Nuclear energy point for 2010.
The red Nuclear energy point for 2010 is positioned higher on the plot than the blue Hydroelectricity point for 2010.
A blue point near 2015 is labeled '35%' and sits at a similar vertical height to the red 2010 point.
The red point near 2015 is the lowest red point on the chart and is labeled '23%'.
A blue point near 2035 is labeled '47%'.
A red point near 2035 is labeled '28%' and sits well below the corresponding blue point.

printed_facts.fact: X-axis is labeled 'Year' with ticks from 2000 to 2050.

public_definitions: Use the planning dashboard to review the 2010 clean-electricity source comparison and route the source record that should receive priority follow-up for the higher generation-share case.
Base the routing decision on the dashboard view comparing Hydroelectricity and Nuclear energy for 2010, and select the source record to advance into the higher-share follow-up workflow.
uncertain: The exact percentage values for the 2010 marks are not printed; the comparison is based on relative vertical position.
The chart uses dual Y-axes (left for Hydroelectricity, right for Nuclear energy), so the absolute values of the two series are not directly comparable on a single scale.
